name_zh: 沙纳纳·古斯芒/东帝汶建国：抵抗建国与石油正义
name_en: Xanana Gusmao/Timor-Leste Founding: Resistance Nation-Building & Oil Justice
description_zh: 东帝汶沙纳纳·古斯芒 (1946-) 抵抗领袖/总统/总理/1975 独立/印尼占领 24 年/1999 公投/2002 恢复独立/帝汶海石油/马鲁克/大阳/澳大利亚谈判/海洋边界条约/石油收益透明/多元化。核心建国逻辑：抵抗合法性/国际法/石油正义/海洋边界/民主巩固/青年/教育/农业/旅游。体现 M202 抵抗建国与石油正义 — 以"游击抵抗合法性+国际法海洋边界+石油收益透明+民主多元化"四位一体，在殖民/占领/独立/资源博弈四重历史中构建最年轻东南亚主权国家。
description_en: Timor-Leste Xanana Gusmao (1946-) resistance leader/president/PM/1975 independence/Indonesian occupation 24 yrs/1999 referendum/2002 restored independence/Timor Sea oil/Greater Sunrise/Australia negotiations/maritime boundary treaty/oil revenue transparency/diversification. Core nation-building logic: resistance legitimacy/international law/oil justice/maritime boundaries/democratic consolidation/youth/education/agriculture/tourism. Exemplifies M202 Resistance Nation-Building & Oil Justice — quaternity of 'guerrilla resistance legitimacy + international law maritime boundaries + oil revenue transparency + democratic diversification' building youngest Southeast Asian sovereign state amid quadruple history of colonial/occupation/independence/resource games.
reason_zh: 东帝汶非单纯后殖民国家，而是"游击抵抗+国际法+石油正义"三位一体建国样本。以游击战建立道德合法性，以国际法院/仲裁确立海洋边界，以石油透明避免资源诅咒。M202 区隔于 M192 游击解放(莫桑比克)、M196 佛教民族主义(缅甸)、M201 人民力量(菲律宾)，核心在于"抵抗即建国合法性+国际法即资源正义+透明即反诅咒"的最年轻主权国家范式。
reason_en: Timor-Leste not mere post-colonial state but 'guerrilla resistance + international law + oil justice' trinity nation-building sample. Guerrilla war built moral legitimacy, ICJ/arbitration established maritime boundaries, oil transparency avoided resource curse. M202 distinct from M192 Guerrilla Liberation (Mozambique), M196 Buddhist Nationalism (Myanmar), M201 People Power (Philippines), core: 'resistance as nation-building legitimacy + international law as resource justice + transparency as anti-curse' youngest sovereign state paradigm.
steps_zh: 游击抵抗建立合法性：1975 FRETILIN 宣布独立/印尼入侵/法林蒂尔游击队/古斯芒指挥/1992 被捕/国际声援/诺贝尔和平奖 1996
国际法确立海洋边界：1999 公投/2002 独立/2006 塔西马尔/2018 海洋边界条约/澳大利亚/大阳/马鲁克/永久法院/仲裁/主权延伸
石油收益透明反诅咒：石油基金/透明度/人类发展/教育/医疗/基建/青年/农业/旅游/避免荷兰病/依赖度下降
民主巩固与多元化：半总统制/多党/权力轮替/古斯芒/奥尔塔/阿劳霍/拉莫斯/青年/女性/分权/地方选举/公民社会
区域融合与东盟成员：东盟观察员/申请入盟/印尼/马来/新加坡/澳/新/中/日/韩/外交/贸易/劳务/安全/最年轻成员
steps_en: Guerrilla resistance builds legitimacy: 1975 FRETILIN declares independence/Indonesian invasion/FALINTIL guerrilla/Gusmao commands/1992 captured/international support/Nobel Peace 1996
International law establishes maritime boundaries: 1999 referendum/2002 independence/2006 CMATS/2018 maritime boundary treaty/Australia/Greater Sunrise/PCA/arbitration/sovereignty extended
Oil revenue transparency anti-curse: Petroleum Fund/transparency/human development/education/healthcare/infra/youth/agriculture/tourism/avoid Dutch disease/dependency declining
Democratic consolidation & diversification: semi-presidential/multi-party/power rotation/Gusmao/Horta/Alkatiri/Ramos-Horta/youth/women/decentralization/local elections/civil society
Regional integration & ASEAN membership: ASEAN observer/applicant/Indonesia/Malaysia/Singapore/Aus/NZ/China/Japan/Korea/diplomacy/trade/labor/security/youngest member
expected_zh: 以"游击抵抗+国际法+石油透明+民主多元"四位一体，在殖民/占领/独立/资源博弈四重历史中构建最年轻东南亚主权国家，为后冲突资源正义提供范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'guerrilla resistance + international law + oil transparency + democratic diversification' builds youngest Southeast Asian sovereign state amid quadruple history of colonial/occupation/independence/resource games, providing paradigm for post-conflict resource justice.
